about: The lite-07 range table: which groups a subscription delivers. rs/moq-net/tests/integration/range_table.rs and js/net/src/range-table.test.ts each run it over lite-07 within their language, and rs/moq-tokio/tests/integration/relay_fill.rs through a JavaScript relay between Rust peers (just test relay-fill).

Modes: direct, the origin's own track; cold, a copy nothing read before; warm, a copy its readers filled from the origin's history; late, a copy its readers joined before the origin wrote a group, so it received each live; chain, a Rust relay's copy, filled by the case's copy readers, serving a reader one relay hop further; switch, a reader moving mid-read from one route to another whose copy the case's copy readers filled (in Rust, each route a relay two hops from the origin), the first stalled after the oldest half of the range and the head of the origin's last group, still open until the switch, so the second supplies the rest, and a reader joining after the switch gets the same; relay-cold and relay-warm, the JavaScript relay's copy.

groups: the origin's group starts in milliseconds, appended (linked by Previous Start) unless append is false. frames: how many frames each group holds, one per millisecond from its start; a reader gets each group it gets whole.
copy: the readers that shape what the copy holds before the case's reader joins; each stays subscribed. evict ages out every group nobody touches but the live edge.
read: the case's reader. ranges default to one with no start; a range's start is a time, or { live } in milliseconds behind the live edge, and its end a time, either omitted for none.
deliver: the group starts the reader gets, in every mode alike. asks: whether the warm copy must ask upstream rather than answer from what it holds, shown by stalling its upstream.

known: a mode, and lang (rs or js) when only one diverges, that still gets the case wrong, skipped until the quest that owns the fix removes the marker. A warm marker covers relay-warm too, and a cold one relay-cold.
